scope.summary: Implement flatten options (CG-23, MD Flattening as Straight Line + merged multi-area flatten + outline point optimization): straight-line-constraint flatten (chosen boundary flattens to a straight edge), multi-area merged flatten into one panel, and flattened-outline point optimization, extending the 3D-surface-to-2D lane (MT-342) per 13.7 ARAP + 13.9 §2.
acceptance_criteria: flatten(regions, straight_edges: [edge refs], merge: bool, optimize_points: bool): ARAP flatten with selected boundary segments constrained straight (pinned collinear); multiple surface areas merge into one panel with internal seam lines recorded; outline point count reduced within 0.3 mm deviation tolerance.
Straight-edge constraint proves: flattened center-back seam is exactly straight in the pattern (fixture).
Flattened panels enter the standard GarmentSpec path (sewable, refittable).
scope.risk_if_missed: Draping-first patternmaking (drape on body, flatten to pattern) needs production-grade flatten options; without straight-edge constraints flattened patterns have wavy fold lines that cannot be cut or graded.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; GUI exposure rides the existing Tailor panels and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the Tailor* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.11/13.14.
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long sim/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
